mentions.name: JevDoom
mentions.description: A parody web page styled as the classic Doom menu, inspired by an AI model that played Doom well. It features working cheat codes, and picking a skill level under NEW GAME boots the shareware Doom episode in the browser using Chocolate Doom compiled to WebAssembly.
mentions.source_excerpt: jevdoom.com – an AI model played Doom and turned out to be pretty good, so I bought the domain. It's a parody page styled as the Doom menu, with working cheat codes. Pick a skill level under NEW GAME and it boots the shareware episode in your browser (Chocolate Doom compiled to WebAssembly).
mentions.author: codeandwaves
